overview_description.description: Wyld is a photo & video challenge app where users compete on stories (photos & videos) that disappear when people stop forwarding them to others. It's a story-spreading competition. The community can either push stories forward to others or drop them. Whether it’s mad skills, epic fails, funny bits, or other awesome moments, Wyld invites users to get creative with their stories and compete on pushes to top the ranks. Top stories on Wyld get rewarded with prizes. The app is made available for mobile and can be downloaded and accessed on a variety of mobile devices.
